newsitem.title: USA: Mission West opts for sale to Lincoln.
newsitem.headline: Mission West opts for sale to Lincoln.

text.p: Mission West Properties said Tuesday it has terminated a sale of its agreement to sell all its real estate assets to DMB/SVP California Investments LLC, opting instead to sell to Lincoln Property Co. NC Inc.
Under the Lincoln Property deal Mission West will receive a total of $46.5 million, an increase of at least $2.0 million over DMB/SVP's original offer.
The new deal is scheduled to close before the end of December 1996. Mission West said the special shareholder meeting to consider the DMB/SVP deal has been canceled.
